To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a four-wave mixing configuration variant is proposed and considered in which the wave frequencies form an ordered sequence of components displaced from each other by one BrillouIN shift.

a four-wave mixing configuration is proposed with a wave-vector difference Δk ≠ 1/2L and with a signal that is much stronger than the reference waves, which ensures the reflection of a strong signal and a large reflection coefficient in a large-aperture mixer.
a configuration variant with a weak reference wave and a strong signal makes it possible to achieve a high reflection coefficient and a high contrast of the reflected signal.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a method for increasing the efficiency of four-wave mixing of waves in a medium with a large transversal size.
the study and analysis of the nonlinear optical effects in the four-wave mixing process in the case of a large wave-vector mismatch.

the development of a new variant of four-wave mixing, in which the wave-vector mismatch between the pump and the signal waves is not compensated by the mismatch between the signal and the reference waves, and the reflected wave is amplified by a signal wave.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the results obtained by the present study are of great significance for the understanding of the physics of the four-wave mixing process and for the development of a new generation of optical instruments.

the present study has provided a clear demonstration of the feasibility of a new type of optical parametric oscillator (OPO) in which a pump wave is converted into a signal and an idler wave by a process of four-wave mixing in an optically isotropic medium.
the present study provides a theoretical basis for further experimental studies of the four-wave mixing with consecutive waves.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed configuration with Δk ≠ 1 makes it possible to obtain an increase in the reflection coefficient by a factor of 5-10 and a reduction in the background noise by a factor of more than 1000.
the proposed four-wave mixing configuration can be used in the construction of high-sensitivity and high-resolution optical instruments.
we have developed a new method of increasing the contrast of the signal reflected in a four-wave mixing configuration.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of a variant of four-wave mixing with a wave-vector matching Δk ≠ 2π/λ is a promising method of creating high-efficiency optical devices for nonlinear optics.

the proposed configuration is a promising basis for a high-sensitivity four-wave mixing instrument for measuring the optical properties of media with small absorption coefficients and small phase shifts.
the use of a variant with Brilluin amplification of the wave makes it possible to significantly improve the characteristics of the nonlinear optical instrument.
